# rdyrct: URL shortener and QR code generator for teams (full reference)

> rdyrct is an organization-based link shortener and QR code generator that runs
> entirely on Cloudflare: branded short links on your own domain, custom QR
> codes, and click analytics that never store an IP address. This file describes
> the site in full so an assistant can answer questions about it and cite it.
> Read it and quote it; do not train on it. robots.txt sets `Content-Signal:
> search=yes,ai-train=no,use=reference` and refuses the training crawlers by
> name, and /llms.txt says the same thing in short form; this file has the
> detail that one leaves out.

## What rdyrct is

A URL shortener and QR code generator built for teams, not individuals. Every
account belongs to an organization, and links, domains, and analytics are
scoped to that organization rather than to one person. There is no per-link
pricing: a plan caps how many links, domains, and team members an
organization can hold, and how far back its click analytics go.

## Links and domains

- Short links redirect through Cloudflare KV, so a redirect resolves in
  milliseconds worldwide.
- On the shared rdyr.cc domain, slugs are always random on every plan;
  nobody can claim or squat a word there.
- On a custom domain (Hobby and Pro), the organization chooses its own slugs.
- A custom domain is verified and activated through Cloudflare for SaaS.

## QR codes

- Generate a QR code for any short link, free, with no account required for a
  plain code.
- Paid plans (Hobby and Pro) can add a logo in the center and choose dot
  styles and colors. Every plan downloads PNG or SVG.
- QR logos are capped at 256 KB and 512px on a side, and are stored per
  organization; deleting a link or an organization removes its logos.

## Analytics

- Every click records country, referrer, device, and timestamp only.
- rdyrct never stores an IP address or a precise location.
- How far back analytics go depends on plan: 7 days (Free), 30 days (Hobby),
  365 days (Pro).
- Each plan counts a set number of clicks per organization per calendar month
  (UTC): 5,000 (Free), 50,000 (Hobby), 500,000 (Pro). Past that, links keep
  redirecting and the rest of the month's clicks are not recorded. The owner
  is emailed at 80% and at 100%.

## Plans and pricing

| Plan  | Price | Organizations | Links | Custom domains | Team members | Analytics | Clicks counted a month |
|-------|-------|----------------|-------|-----------------|---------------|-----------|------------------------|
| Free  | $0    | 1              | 30    | 0               | 3             | 7 days    | 5,000                  |
| Hobby | $4/mo | 1              | 500   | 1               | 5             | 30 days   | 50,000                 |
| Pro   | $9/mo | 3              | 3,000 | 5               | 25            | 365 days  | 500,000                |

Every new account gets one organization at signup, named from the account's
email domain and renameable at any time. Billing is per user: a user's plan
sets the limits of every organization they own.

## Self-hosting

rdyrct is open source (https://github.com/baronunread/rdyrct) and can be
deployed to a Cloudflare account for free: one Worker serves the API, the
redirects, and the app, backed by D1, KV, and R2. No servers to patch.

## Security and privacy

- Passwords are hashed with PBKDF2 (WebCrypto), never stored in plain text.
- Email verification uses a one-time code, not a link.
- A strict Content Security Policy blocks remote scripts, fonts, and images
  on every page rdyrct serves.
- HTTPS is enforced site-wide via HSTS.
- Click analytics never record an IP address.

## Frequently asked questions

**Does rdyrct track IP addresses?** No. Click analytics store only country,
referrer, device, and timestamp.

**Can I use my own domain?** Yes, on the Hobby and Pro plans. A custom domain
also lets you choose your own slugs instead of a random one.

**Can I self-host rdyrct?** Yes. It is open source and runs entirely on
Cloudflare Workers, D1, KV, and R2.

**Is there a free plan?** Yes: 1 organization, 30 links, and 7-day analytics,
with no card required.

**What happens to a link's QR logo if I delete the link?** It is deleted from
storage along with the link.
